# Deck3 — Universal Times New Roman Typography Standard V1
**Binding scope:** Deck3 All Forms, Dossiya Expert Deck3 figures, AI-generated visual assets, native editable PPTX, mathematical figures, animations, notes, titles, citations, legends and references.

1. Use **Times New Roman** for every authored text string everywhere in the 14-slide presentation: headings, slide body, note captions, chart labels, axis ticks, equations when textual, figure labels, symbols when typographically supported, image inscriptions and animated native objects. Keep real OMML math semantics and mathematical readability; Times New Roman font declaration must not replace mathematical notation incorrectly.
2. Prefer **zero generated text inside AI raster equipment imagery**. Generate authentic equipment objects alone, then place all precise text, citations, equations, measurements and arrows as Times New Roman editable PowerPoint layers. If words inside a rendered scientific image are unavoidable, explicitly prompt Times New Roman and visually inspect glyphs and exact spelling; never claim machine verification from prompts.
3. Set slide runs and defaults, master/layout default Latin fonts, PowerPoint theme major/minor Latin, and editable chart/shape font runs to Times New Roman. In generated SVG specify `font-family="Times New Roman",serif`, and validate any rasterized SVG. For existing full-slide images with text, rebuild or remove text as native objects; mere PPTX font substitution cannot change pixels.
4. Require exact `.github/skills/deck3/references/DECK3_SRGB_PALETTE.json` 13-color palette for **all authored design marks, including theme color defaults**. All backgrounds/panels are #FFFFFF; only semantic borders, arrows, headings, lines and tiny approved accents are colored. Use original photorealistic object colors without artificial quantization; no shadows, gradients, colored fills or decorative hue additions.
5. Preserve citations next to supported claims (author–year), original thesis mathematics and exact frozen objectives; references slide only verified journal articles. Animation should reveal Times New Roman native objects on click and keep scientific meaning intact.
6. For a release audit: report explicit fonts in all slide, layout, master and theme XML; inspect text visibility at projection scale; detect raster-embedded letterforms and state `RASTER_TEXT_NOT_VERIFIED` when pixel inspection is not done; verify all explicit and theme sRGB colors are approved; record animation-target XML audit separately from desktop playback; do not label PASS for unperformed checks.
7. This is an additional typography/color contract; it does not replace physical mechanism, rights, 160-sample retrieval, or source governance. Font selection does not validate scientific physics.

**Canonical name:** Times New Roman (not “New Time Roman”).
